remedy_paths.label: Targeted condition repair
remedy_paths.summary: Strengthen execution coherence directly - the single weakest dimension - before touching anything else, so the institution carries more of its own performance.
actions: Isolate the specific failures driving execution coherence rather than treating the dimension as a whole.
Assign clear ownership for the repair and a date to re-measure.
Hold the other dimensions steady so the change is attributable.
remedy_paths.benefit: Lowest-disruption path; addresses the binding constraint without destabilizing what already works.
remedy_paths.risk: If the weakness is broader than one dimension, a targeted repair may need to be followed by wider work.

remedy_paths.label: Condition and dependence review
remedy_paths.summary: Pair the repair to execution coherence with a review of where output currently depends on extra effort and management overhead, so durable capacity replaces borrowed performance.
actions: Map where current output depends on individual heroics or manager intervention.
Convert the most load-bearing informal practices into durable, owned routines.
Re-run from a second perspective to test whether the same dependence is visible from another vantage point.
remedy_paths.benefit: Pairs the primary fix with a test of whether informal-absorption dependence can be reduced before conditions change.
remedy_paths.risk: Requires honest visibility into informal effort, which can be uncomfortable to surface.

remedy_paths.label: Full institutional rebuild
remedy_paths.summary: Rebuild the unit’s execution, confidence, and adaptive routines end to end.
actions: Secure an explicit leadership mandate before starting - this path needs one.
Sequence the rebuild so performance is protected while routines are replaced.
Stand up measurement before, during, and after to test whether the measured condition changes as intended.
remedy_paths.benefit: Provides the broadest route for testing whether institutional routines can be rebuilt coherently.
remedy_paths.risk: Heavy and disruptive, but credible when the condition is genuinely degraded across most dimensions.
